the cobra cardiotoxins (CTs), a family of small basic peptides, exerted dual effect on the vascular smooth muscle cells (VSMCs) and the endothelium.

(1) the cardiotoxin from cobra venom (CTX) induces a biphasic effect on rat aortic rings: it causes an endothelium-independent contraction followed by relaxation; (2) the endothelial relaxation is mediated by NO release; and (3) CTX induces endothelial cell death.
